paragraphs.source_en: "His mother came home happy with the kind answer of the principal who said he would think about it. The good news from the principal had been waited with great hope. They had waited and waited from month to month until at last Mr. Koga was sent for to call upon the principal. He did so, and was told that the school fund being short he could not manage to raise his salary, but finding a better place in Nobeoka where Mr. Koga could have five yen more a month, he had taken necessary steps to that end, believing it just answered his wish." "It was a command, and not a consultation."
